name: The Morrow Stone
summary: The moment you take the artifact from the Equinex Monolith, the power in the Stave of Equinex starts to fade. You are to bring the Sparkling Stone and the stave back to Troyas Moonbreeze at Feathermoon Stronghold.

sections.title: Back to Feathermoon Stronghold
sections.body: As the artifact leaves the monolith, the stave's energy starts to fade. Troyas Moonbreeze at Feathermoon Stronghold is eager to hear what you found, so bring both the Sparkling Stone and the stave to him.

sections.title: Troyas's Findings
sections.body: Troyas has been reading since you left, and he names the stone the Morrow Stone. He is not yet sure of its purpose, but anything hidden inside the monolith the way it was must carry great significance. He will go on with his studies and hopes you will stand with him.

aliases: where do I get this quest
faq.answer: At the Equinex Monolith, once the artifact has been taken from it.

faq.q: Who do I bring the stone to?
faq.answer: Troyas Moonbreeze, in Feathermoon Stronghold. Bring the Stave of Equinex too.

faq.q: What happens to the Stave of Equinex?
aliases: why did the stave lose power
faq.answer: Its energy starts to fade the moment the artifact is taken from the monolith.

aliases: what quest comes before the morrow stone
faq.answer: It follows The Stave of Equinex, in which you energized the stave beside the monolith.
